title: BMO listener pass-through
what: The narrow pass-through to BMO's console under /bmo: the four routes a display uses, the request headers forwarded, the answer streamed as it comes, and BMO's refusal replaced by this server's own words.

title: Face server routes
what: Everything the face server answers under /bmo-face: the generated screen and its build manifest, the document and its saves stream, the editor login routes, the pass-through, and the write origin check and body limit before anything is read.

title: Editor sign-in
what: The editor's login: a name and password checked against BMO's web_users in the archive, a session in the face's own database, the bmo_face cookie, and a throttle on failed logins from one address.

title: Expression tool entry
what: The face/expression entry of BMO's tool host: the emotion a briefing is spoken with answered as the face it shows, read as one call on standard input and answered on standard output with the schema's default.
